caption: The drawing is a pencil sketch of a large mug or tankard with a pronounced handle, displayed in side profile and centered within a rectangular border on an off-white or beige paper background. The mug is cylindrical with straight sides that slightly taper outward toward the base and has two horizontal decorative bands around its midsection. The handle is large, curving outward and then looping downward and inward, ending in a small decorative curl at the bottom. There are two smaller inset technical drawings: one at the lower left corner showing a top, side, and profile view of the handle, and one at the lower right corner showcasing the tankard’s geometric outline with measurements indicated. The shading of the mug suggests a metallic or reflective surface, primarily using gray tones. There are handwritten notations indicating "MEYERS," "SCALE 1/1," and some numerical measurements. The lines are precise, with careful shading to show dimensionality and texture, and the entire composition maintains a technical and illustrative style.
title: Pewter Mug
